WebPlayer - WebXR Media Player

WebXR media player with HLS.js and DASH.js support. Immersive video streaming with adaptive quality and Rust WebAssembly optimization for low-latency playback.

Features include HLS adaptive streaming, DASH protocol support, WebXR integration for immersive viewing, automatic quality switching, multi-device support, and low latency mode for real-time streaming.

Supports MP4/H.264, WebM/VP9, HLS/m3u8, DASH/mpd, and WebRTC formats with hardware acceleration and adaptive bitrate streaming for optimal viewing experience across all devices.

Perfect for immersive media experiences, live streaming, video on demand, and professional broadcasting applications requiring WebXR integration and low-latency playback.
